title: Eleven Villages and One River
subtitle: 能源利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 能源利用（环境保护·能源与可再生）
meta: 主题语境：能源利用（环境保护·能源与可再生）　|　核心词汇：scale　|　正文 307 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 scale 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① scale of the scheme, when the engineers first described it in 1998, was eleven villages and one river, and my grandfather asked the only question anybody remembers: who decides what scale is the right one? He said a scheme built on the wrong ② scale does not fail, it simply becomes somebody else's, which is what happened, and that the scale is the first thing decided and the last thing questioned.

He weighed everything. There were ③ scales in the shed, brass and older than he was, and he weighed the coal, the grain and, once, in 1974, my sister. He said a man who does not weigh his own fuel is guessing, and that guessing is how you end up building ④ on a large scale something nobody asked for.

The map they were shown was drawn to a ⑤ scale of one to twenty-five thousand: the river a blue line, the eleven villages eleven dots. My grandfather called it the most dishonest object in the room. He asked them to ⑥ scale it up — to draw one village, one house, one chimney — and they could not, because nobody had drawn one at that scale.

In the end the station was built at eleven times what the villages needed, and the ⑦ economy of scale, as the report called it, sent the surplus to a city that had asked for none of it. My grandfather, asked afterwards to rate the scheme ⑧ on a scale of one to ten, said it was a nine for the city and a two for us, which nobody wrote down.

The ⑨ full scale of what we had agreed to became clear in 2003, when the first bill arrived. He died in 2007. The ⑩ scale of the thing, eleven villages and one river, is still the largest number I have had anything to do with.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n.[pl.] 天平；秤（a pair of scales）
C. n. 比例尺（a scale of one to ...）
D. 固定搭配：on a large / small scale 大规模地／小规模地
E. 固定搭配：scale up / down 扩大／缩小规模
F. 固定搭配：economy of scale 规模经济
G. 固定搭配：on a scale of ... to ... 按……到……的等级／量表
H. n. 程度；严重性（the full scale of ...）

items.q: a scheme built on the wrong scale
There were scales in the shed
drawn to a scale of one to twenty-five thousand
He asked them to scale it up

answers.why: the scale of ... 意为“……的规模”，1998 年工程师说的规模是十一个村庄和一条河。
scale 意为“规模”，规模不对的方案不会失败，只会变成别人的。
scales 复数意为“天平、秤”，棚屋里那台黄铜天平比他年纪还大。
on a large scale 意为“大规模地”，猜测会让人大规模建起没人要的东西。
a scale of one to ... 意为“比例尺”，那张地图是一比二万五千。
scale up 意为“放大、扩大规模”，他让他们放大来画一个村庄、一栋房子、一根烟囱。
economy of scale 意为“规模经济”，报告用这个词把多余的电送去了没要电的城市。
on a scale of ... to ... 意为“按……的量表／等级”，请他按一到十分给方案打分。
the full scale of ... 意为“……的全部程度／严重性”，2003 年第一张账单来时才看清。
the scale of ... 意为“规模”，十一个村庄和一条河，是我接触过最大的规模。
